item.title: He Called Her His Wife. She Was His Missing Student.
item.description: Tad Cummins claimed 15-year-old Elizabeth Thomas was his adult wife while hiding in California in 2017. A caretaker’s tip ended the 38-day search for the Tennessee student. Cummins pleaded guilty to federal sex and obstruction offenses and received 20 years in prison.

item.title: Her Followers Kept Her Body Wrapped In Christmas Lights
item.description: Amy Carlson, 45, led Love Has Won as “Mother God.” Police found her body wrapped in Christmas lights in Colorado in April 2021. An autopsy linked her death to alcohol abuse, anorexia and chronic colloidal silver ingestion. All charges against seven followers were dropped.

item.title: She Insured Her Housemate The Day Before A Fatal Fall
item.description: Deana Wild, 20, died after falling from a Big Sur cliff in 1987. Virginia McGinnis had bought a $35,000 life insurance policy on her just one day earlier. Convicted of murder for financial gain in 1992, McGinnis was sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: The Warning Susan Powell Locked In A Safe Deposit Box
item.description: After Utah mother Susan Cox Powell vanished in December 2009, investigators found her hidden will: “If I die, it may not be an accident.” Her husband Josh became the prime suspect but was never charged in her disappearance. Susan remains missing.

item.title: A Red Car Drove Away. Tabitha Tuders Was Gone
item.description: Tabitha Tuders, 13, vanished while walking to her Nashville school bus stop on April 29, 2003. Police say a red car stopped near where she was last seen; when it left, she was gone. She remains missing, and the FBI offers a reward of up to $50,000.

item.title: The Luggage Ticket Hidden In Myra Hindley’s Prayer Book
item.description: A ticket hidden in Myra Hindley’s prayer book linked her to suitcases at Manchester Central station containing evidence of Lesley Ann Downey’s murder. Hindley and Ian Brady received life sentences in 1966. Keith Bennett, one of their five victims, has never been found.

item.title: She Fought Off Her Neighbor And Exposed A Serial Killer
item.description: Michelle Murphy survived a 2008 attack in her Santa Monica home, leaving investigators with DNA that identified her neighbor, Michael Gargiulo. He was convicted of murdering Ashley Ellerin and Maria Bruno and attempting to murder Murphy, then sentenced to death in 2021.
